denmark.title: Flag of Denmark (Dannebrog)

colors.note: Represents battle and the blood of the Danish people
Represents the cross of Christianity, peace, and unity

desc:
- A white Nordic cross on a red field, the oldest continuously used national flag in the world
- Legend holds it fell from the sky during the Battle of Lindanise in 1219
- **Construction:** a red field with a white Scandinavian cross
- The vertical arm of the cross is offset toward the hoist
- The cross arms are 1/7 of the flag's height in width
- Official ratio is 28:37
denmark.subtitle: Dannebrog — oldest national flag in continuous use (since 1219)
trivia:
- The Dannebrog, dating to 1219, is considered the oldest continuously used national flag in the world
- The white cross represents Christianity; the red represents Danish courage
- Legend says it fell from the sky during the Battle of Lyndanisse in Estonia, a religious miracle
